# Reconciliation Fix - Rollout Plan

**Status:** Approved by Marcus Bell 2026-10-10. Deploy window Monday night. Fix described in Reconciliation Discrepancy - Fractional Shares Investigation.

## Goal

Get the precision and corporate-actions fix into production early enough for three clean nightly reconciliation runs before go/no-go #2 on 2026-10-16. Then unfreeze ETF-5 in the app.

## What ships

1. Migration: position quantity columns to `numeric(20,8)`.
2. Corporate-actions ingester v2: handles `FRAC_ADJ` and every documented type; unknown types fail closed.
3. Post-action re-snapshot from DriveWealth's positions API.
4. Backfill job for the 49 affected ETF-5 positions (46 users), run once, reviewed output.

All behind `investing.ca_v2` except the migration.

## Schedule

| When (PT) | Step | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Sat Oct 10 | PR approved; final review comments addressed | Devon |
| Mon Oct 12, 20:00 | Migration on production (tested: 4 min, no lock over 200ms) | Devon |
| Mon Oct 12, 20:30 | Deploy `brokerd` with ingester v2, flag off | Devon |
| Mon Oct 12, 21:00 | Backfill in dry-run; diff to #investing-recon | Devon |
| Tue Oct 13, 09:00 | Hana and Marcus review the dry-run diff | Hana, Marcus |
| Tue Oct 13, 11:00 | Backfill for real; flag on | Devon |
| Wed Oct 14, 02:00 ET | Nightly run 1 | automatic |
| Thu Oct 15, 02:00 ET | Nightly run 2 | automatic |
| Fri Oct 16, 02:00 ET | Nightly run 3, report at 06:00 PT, before go/no-go #2 | Devon |
| After a clean run 3 | Unfreeze ETF-5 in the app | Devon |

Note: run 3 lands the morning of the go/no-go. No slack. If review on Tuesday slips, we go into go/no-go with two clean runs, not three.

## Success criteria

- 0 quantity mismatches for ETF-5 after backfill.
- Overall quantity mismatches at or below the beta baseline (0-3 timing items a night).
- No unknown-event freezes. If one fires, that's the new code working; investigate before calling it a failure.

## Rollback

- Ingester: flag `investing.ca_v2` off. Old ingester resumes. ETF-5 stays frozen.
- Backfill: every corrected row keeps its prior value in `position_corrections`. Revert script tested on the snapshot.
- Migration: not rolled back. Wider precision is backward compatible.

## Comms

- No customer notice (Hana Ito's decision, 2026-09-18). ETF-5 has shown "updating" since Sep 15.
- Daily status in #investing-launch through Oct 16.
- Result goes in Notion: Go-No-Go 2 - Agenda.

Decision: if run 3 is clean, I recommend we treat reconciliation as unblocked for GA. If run 2 or 3 shows any ETF-5 mismatch, it stays a blocker.

Risk: I'm also on the hook for the Sidekiq ACH deletion by Oct 16 (Sidekiq ACH Decommission Plan). Reconciliation comes first; PR 3 there may slip a few days, and I've told Marcus.

- [ ] Devon: production migration and flag-off deploy by 2026-10-12
- [ ] Hana: review backfill dry-run diff by 2026-10-13
- [ ] Marcus: review backfill dry-run diff by 2026-10-13
- [ ] Devon: reconciliation fix live with flag on by 2026-10-14
- [ ] Devon: report three nightly runs to go/no-go #2 by 2026-10-16
